annotations.title: Get the steps for a task

description: A checklist of the recommended steps for one kind of task: which TrueInterview tools apply and in what order, which facts come from the candidate, and the limits TrueInterview keeps (the candidate sends every application and message). It is the same text as the open-source TrueInterview skills. task: overview (what holds for every task), kickoff (first session), find_jobs, check_fit, resume, apply (answering one application form), tracker, inbox (recruiter email), prep (one company’s interviews) or reach_out. Free, read-only, the same for everyone.
name: get_playbook
title: Get the steps for a task
